[[File:HothLichen-WoSW.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Lichen found in the caves of Hoth]]
'''Lichens''' were small, adaptable [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] that grew symbiotically with [[Algae/Legends|algae]], resulting in a composite organism that characteristically formed a crustlike or branching growth on surfaces such as rocks or [[Tree/Legends|tree]] trunks. Able to grow in almost any climate, lichens could be found from the freezing tundras of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

Fields of lichens grew in Hoth's vast [[Cave/Legends|cave]] grottoes, providing an important source of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] for wild [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntauns]]. These [[Species/Legends|animals]] also sometimes found lichens on exposed outcroppings on the surface and just below the frost layer. There are two varieties of lichen on Hoth, wall and floor.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref><ref name="The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

Lichens also could grow on some rocks of the arid world of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]].<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>

The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] used [[glow-lichen]] to provide light. [[Eol Sha lichen]] was eaten by the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] colonists.
